rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Every pronoun/demonstrative checked against a sequential read: chunk 1 line 12 'them'/'they' forward-point to the bulleted task-size list two lines below within the SAME chunk (in-chunk forward reference, not cross-chunk); chunk 3 line 40 'that repo' resolves to chunk 2's 'Pick THE repo' (line 24, sequential); chunk 8 line 80 'The bug you picked' resolves to chunk 6's bug-screen (session-artifact carve-out). No never-named or vague-with-history referent found in any of the 9 chunks. Harm check: a broken referent here would strand a reader mid-slide; none found, so no REVISE.

Two links to other documents: chunk 2 line 34 '[build one from zero](trainings/agentic-engineering-101/supplementary/build-a-project-from-zero.md)' names the target inline ('build one from zero'), not located by position; chunk 7 line 76 Willison link is named by title and author in the same sentence. Neither points at another file by position ('the opening lecture said'). No cross-file positional callback found.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal construction anywhere in the body; prework has no live-demo beat.

Thinnest chunk is chunk 3 ('2. Open a Claude Code session in that repo', 20 words per check-slide-size.js) but still carries a self-standing instruction ('Open a new Claude Code session at the repo you just picked. CLI or desktop both work.') — not a bare wait-state. Every other chunk carries substantially more standalone content. No orphan found.

Checked all 8 headers against their chunk content: 'Bring real work' (chunk 1) is the header the content the chunk's own content contradicts test applied — content lists task sizes to bring, consistent; 'Bring to Module 1' (chunk 8) content is exactly what to bring plus the opening question, consistent. No header the content contradicts.

Checked all 5 sub-items across all 9 chunks: no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction; no anaphora/epistrophe triple; no self-grading superlative (nothing like 'one of the most useful moves'); no number-plus-retraction; no abstraction-noun stack; no empty-leg verb triplet. Clean across the file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No repo/maintainer vocabulary (compendium, forcing function, beat, mood, surface-as-noun, firing) found in body prose. 'Plan mode' (chunk 1, line 16) is a real Claude Code feature name, ordinary to the engineer audience, not repo-internal dialect.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 7 "Pre-read before Module 1": line 76 bolds '**Read: Simon Willison, [Vibe engineering](...)**' — the whole mode-word-plus-author-plus-title, not the mode word alone. The compendium names this exact shape as the violation: 'bold the mode word alone (`**Read:**`, `**Watch:**`) and leave the title plain. Bolding mode-plus-title is the pre-2026-07-09 monoculture wearing a list for cover.' The reading-list carve-out lifts the per-slide budget here but not the handle cap, and this bold exceeds it in kind, not just word count. Harm: low (single one-item pre-read slide, not a multi-item scan surface where the pattern would actually mislead) but the rule is unambiguous and the shape matches its own named failure verbatim. Chunk 1's four bulleted task-size bolds ('Trivial bug', 'A small multi-file task', etc.) are checklist-item-name handles, ≲5 words each, explicitly allowed by the base rule — not flagged. The de-bolded 'Separate tasks off your backlog.' (chunk 1, line 20) now carries no bold and does not contribute to any over-budget finding — the de-bold this session correctly cleared the prior rule-9 finding on that line.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Bold only 'Read:' and leave 'Simon Willison, Vibe engineering (October 2025)' plain.
